implemented: R38: clusters of 1/2/4 CTAs with TMA multicast of B tile

Decode ~300 cycles fits ~95 instructions per warp per chunk
failed: No-MMA decode was dead code (16 cycles)

name: RE10
failed: Slower: 753 e2e 617 vs 587 us; g1 full-wait 388 vs 276 cycles
verdict: Lane-0 polling is worse; shared-memory waits behind wgmma suspected.

name: RE11
worked: Decode grows with in-flight MMA: 318 cycles at N 47, 497 at N 121
verdict: Decode and wgmma issue serialize per scheduler; no speedup.

name: RE12
implemented: Ping-pong wgmma issue via named barriers (variant 10)
failed: No gain: 753 721 vs 700 us; g1 loop 797 vs 786 cycles; 16K 896 vs 878
